description: This file defines the EventFactory class in the org.apache.ofbiz.webapp.event package. It acts as a factory to load and provide event handler instances based on configuration, primarily used within the web application's event handling framework.

classes.name: EventFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for loading event handlers from configuration and providing access to them based on event type.

methods.name: EventFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes event handlers from the configuration URL.

methods.name: getEventHandler
methods.description: Retrieves an event handler instance for a given event type.
